info.title: Lumeus RPC: getNetwork
info.description:
Lumeus RPC: Stellar JSON-RPC 2.0 over `POST /`, with Lumeus keys, metering and limits. Sign up at https://app.lumeus.dev: Free, Starter, Growth and Scale plans are self-serve, Enterprise by agreement.

- **Pricing.** Testnet is free: Testnet requests cost no credits and are never billed. Each organization can make 10,000 Testnet requests a day across Activity, Assets and RPC (unlimited on Enterprise); the count resets at 00:00 UTC, and a request over it answers 429 rate_limited with Retry-After set to the seconds until then. Mainnet requests draw from the plan's monthly credits. A Mainnet call costs its method credits plus one credit per started 64 KiB of response. Each call of a batch counts as one request, and a batch that would cross the daily Testnet cap is refused whole. Plans, limits and credit weights: `GET https://api.lumeus.dev/v1/plans`.
- **Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Testnet: `lum_test_…`; Mainnet: `lum_live_…`. A key works only on its own network, so pick the server that matches it (the other network answers 401). Publishable `lum_pub_…` keys call read-only methods only, from an allowed browser origin. Dashboard sessions and webhook keys are not accepted.
- **Headers.** Every response carries X-Request-Id; authenticated responses carry RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; 429 and 503 carry Retry-After.
- **Errors.** JSON-RPC 2.0 error objects. Gateway errors carry the machine-readable code as the string error.data and the request ID as error.request_id (see [errors](/guides/errors)). A JSON-RPC error can arrive with HTTP 200, from the node or for one call of a batch, so check error before reading result. The REST routes (`/operations/...`, `/healthz`, `/readyz`) answer flat JSON errors.
- **CORS.** Browser calls (CORS) are allowed from https://docs.lumeus.dev (the Try it playground of this reference) and https://app.lumeus.dev only, without cookies; responses expose ETag, Link, Location, Retry-After, X-Request-Id, X-Lumeus-Operation-Id, X-Lumeus-Idempotency and RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset (errors included). Other websites cannot read responses made with a server key: use a publishable key with your own allowed origins ([browser keys](/guides/browser-keys)).

tags.name: JSON-RPC
tags.description: Stellar JSON-RPC 2.0 over `POST /`: one call or a batch of up to 20. Each method has its own page with parameters, result fields and a real response.

post.description:
Returns the network passphrase and the current protocol version.

- On Mainnet a call costs 1 credit plus one per started 64 KiB of response; Testnet calls are free and count toward the daily Testnet request cap.
- Send an id: a call without one is a notification and gets an empty 204.
- The result fields are listed under the 200 response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional, and not used for deduplication: the response then carries X-Lumeus-Idempotency: ignored. To retry sendTransaction safely, resubmit the same signed envelope (the node answers DUPLICATE).

200.description: The getNetwork result. Check error before reading result.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifier of this request: req_ followed by 24 hex characters. Error bodies repeat it as request_id. Quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests per minute of the bucket that answered: the plan rate, the dashboard session floor of 120, or a publishable key's per-IP rate.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Whole requests left in the bucket after this one.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the bucket is full again.

X-Lumeus-Idempotency.description: ignored when you sent an Idempotency-Key: RPC does not deduplicate. Resubmit the same signed envelope to retry sendTransaction safely.

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import json
import os

import requests

res = requests.post(
    "https://rpc-testnet.lumeus.dev/",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['LUMEUS_API_KEY']}"},
    json={
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "getNetwork"
    },
    timeout=30,
)
print(res.status_code, json.dumps(res.json(), indent=2))

Bearer.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Testnet: `lum_test_…`; Mainnet: `lum_live_…`. A key works only on its own network, so pick the server that matches it (the other network answers 401). Publishable `lum_pub_…` keys call read-only methods only, from an allowed browser origin. Dashboard sessions and webhook keys are not accepted.

error.description: Human-readable message. It may change; branch on code.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Branch on code, not on the error text, which may change. RPC carries the same codes as the string error.data of a JSON-RPC error. invalid_request: 400: invalid input, including a malformed Idempotency-Key or an unknown or repeated query parameter (Webhooks also uses it for an oversized request body, 413). Fix the request; do not retry unchanged. unauthorized: 401: missing, revoked, invalid or wrong-network credential. payment_required: 402 (Mainnet): monthly credit quota exhausted on a hard-capped plan. forbidden: 403: the key or account policy does not allow this action. not_found: 404 (Webhooks also 410): the resource does not exist in this organization and network. topic_search_disabled: 404: contract-event topic search is not enabled on this network. method_not_allowed: 405: the route does not accept this method. conflict: 409: conflicting request identity, idempotency key, funding or recovery state. generation_changed: 409: the index generation or network changed since the snapshot was taken; restart the walk without generation and snapshot_ledger. history_unavailable: 409 (Assets): as_of_ledger is not answered from the balance history; start a snapshot job (POST /snapshots) or retry later. precondition_failed: 412 (Webhooks): the subscription version changed; fetch the current ETag. response_too_large: 413: the result exceeds the response budget; lower limit or narrow the request. precondition_required: 428 (Webhooks): If-Match with the subscription ETag is required. rate_limited: 429: a rate, concurrency or credit-cap limit was reached, or (Activity, Assets and RPC on Testnet) the daily Testnet request cap (message `daily Testnet request cap of 10000 reached; resets at 00:00 UTC`, Retry-After until 00:00 UTC). Wait Retry-After seconds (a refused request consumes nothing). A Retry-After greater than 60 means the daily Testnet cap: wait until 00:00 UTC or switch to Mainnet. RPC carries it as the string error.data. internal_error: 500 or another unexpected 5xx; quote request_id when contacting support. not_implemented: 501: the feature is not enabled on this host. busy: 503: reads are saturated (the queue wait expired or the database refused another query or ran short of memory). Retry the same request after Retry-After (2) seconds. query_timeout: 503: the read ran out of time. Do not retry unchanged right away: narrow the ledger range (since_ledger/until_ledger) or lower limit; Retry-After is 30. index_not_ready: 503: the index or snapshot is not ready yet or is rebuilding; retry after Retry-After seconds. topic_coverage: 503: the effective range is outside the contract-event topic index coverage (the message states it); pass a range inside it or retry after Retry-After (60) seconds. unavailable: 503: another temporary failure (billing, rate limiter, queue); retry after Retry-After seconds.

request_id.description: Identifier of this request, the same value as the X-Request-Id header. Quote it when contacting support.

id.description: Request ID, echoed in the response. Send one on every call: a call without an id is a notification, which runs but gets an empty 204 response. A string ID (at most 1024 bytes) also works and is echoed unchanged.

params.description: This method takes no parameters: omit params, send null (as stellar-sdk does) or send `{}`.

getNetwork.title: getNetwork
getNetwork.description: Returns the network passphrase and the current protocol version. 1 credit plus one per started 64 KiB of response. Named params only (positional arrays are rejected). A params member set to null (as Python stellar-sdk sends for unset options) is treated as omitted at any depth.

code.description: JSON-RPC code. Gateway errors: -32700 parse error, -32600 invalid request (also a body over 1 MiB), -32601 unsupported method, -32602 invalid params, -32000 policy or availability (401, 402, 403, 413 response too large, 429, 503). Errors from the Stellar node keep its own code.

message.description: Human-readable; may change. Branch on data.

data.description: Gateway errors: the machine-readable code as a plain string, so that every Stellar SDK can parse it. The values are the shared error codes plus submission_outcome_unknown. Errors from the Stellar node keep the node's own data, if any. invalid_request: 400: invalid input, including a malformed Idempotency-Key or an unknown or repeated query parameter (Webhooks also uses it for an oversized request body, 413). Fix the request; do not retry unchanged. unauthorized: 401: missing, revoked, invalid or wrong-network credential. payment_required: 402 (Mainnet): monthly credit quota exhausted on a hard-capped plan. forbidden: 403: the key or account policy does not allow this action. not_found: 404 (Webhooks also 410): the resource does not exist in this organization and network. method_not_allowed: 405: the route does not accept this method. conflict: 409: conflicting request identity, idempotency key, funding or recovery state. response_too_large: 413: the result exceeds the response budget; lower limit or narrow the request. rate_limited: 429: a rate, concurrency or credit-cap limit was reached, or (Activity, Assets and RPC on Testnet) the daily Testnet request cap (message `daily Testnet request cap of 10000 reached; resets at 00:00 UTC`, Retry-After until 00:00 UTC). Wait Retry-After seconds (a refused request consumes nothing). A Retry-After greater than 60 means the daily Testnet cap: wait until 00:00 UTC or switch to Mainnet. RPC carries it as the string error.data. internal_error: 500 or another unexpected 5xx; quote request_id when contacting support. unavailable: 503: another temporary failure (billing, rate limiter, queue); retry after Retry-After seconds. submission_outcome_unknown: 503 (RPC sendTransaction only): the transaction reached the node but its answer was lost; poll getTransaction with error.transaction_hash before building a new transaction. Resubmitting the same signed envelope is safe (the node answers DUPLICATE).

request_id.description: Gateway errors: the same value as the X-Request-Id header; quote it when contacting support.

transaction_hash.description: submission_outcome_unknown only: the hash of the submitted transaction. Poll getTransaction with it.

id.description: The id of your call, echoed unchanged (a string id comes back as a string). null when the gateway cannot read the id, for example for invalid JSON.

result.description: The getNetwork result, as returned by stellar-rpc 29.

RPCResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response: result on success, error otherwise. A JSON-RPC error can arrive with HTTP 200 (for example from the node, or for one child of a batch). Gateway errors carry the code string in error.data and the request ID in error.request_id; they echo your id when the body is a parseable single request and use a null id when it cannot be determined. Preserve integer IDs exactly; avoid unsafe JavaScript numeric IDs. The gateway never answers 502 or 504.

friendbotUrl.description: Friendbot URL, on networks that have one.

passphrase.description: Network passphrase to sign transactions with.

HTTP429.description: error.data rate_limited: the plan rate (each batch child counts as one request), gateway concurrency (after a short queue), node capacity, or on Testnet the daily Testnet request cap (each batch child counts; a batch that would cross the cap is refused whole, and every call in it gets the error; Retry-After is the time until 00:00 UTC). A call refused for node capacity was not executed, including sendTransaction. A request made only of notifications gets the status with an empty body. Wait Retry-After seconds. A rate_limited answer whose Retry-After is greater than 60 is the daily Testnet cap: wait until 00:00 UTC or switch to Mainnet.
